headline: Sun Belt Palm-Reading Panic Forces 340,000 Residents to Flee Subdivisions Overnight
deck: Local landlords declare 'doom lines' after a gripping revelation, while FEMA opens financial omen shelters stocked with hand sanitizer.
article:
Over 340,000 Sun Belt subdivision residents abandoned their homes after landlords invoked 'doom lines'—palmistry thresholds tied to residential stability.

Dr. Felicity Palmington of the University of Phoenix Palmistry Lab linked weak Saturn lines to a 37 percent rise in handshake-loan defaults. "Feeble lines predict financial calamity," she said while tracing creases on her own palm.

The Phoenix Homeowners Association now demands quarterly grip-strength tests for pool access. Residents crowd grip boot camps as gyms report record sign-ups. "I never expected to train my handshake," said local Janice Hargrove.

FEMA opened financial-omen shelters stocked with sanitizer and blank lease forms for the displaced. Officials continue drafting handshake-firmness rules, eyeing a possible national standard.
author: Daryl Pritchett, Senior Financial Correspondent

oped.title: Hats Off to Doom: Why Palm Panic Exposes Weak Tenants
oped.author: Lord Percival Handwaver, Certified Doomsayer and Former Landlord to the Stars
oped.body: The Sun Belt flight shows modern tenants cannot stomach their own palm facts. Landlords simply exposed what credit scores hid: doom lines carved into tenant flesh. The fugitives' wide-brimmed hats, not the readings, deserve blame for casting shadows on those lifelines. Shaving every resident's palms would reveal the truth faster than FEMA's sanitizer stockpiles and might spare my own holdings from further inspection, since my handshake has long masked minor flaws.

Lost & Found: Misplaced my certified handshake certificate during the 340,000-person exodus. If found, return for one sanitized reading and no questions about the faint doom branch.
Personals: Single renter, palm freshly sanitized, seeks roommate whose lifeline doesn't cross a foreclosure fork. Must demonstrate unbreakable handshake; credit scores never applied here.

stories.headline: Regional Banks Record Sharp Fall in Handshake Firmness Scores Following Suburb Exodus
stories.deck: Loan officers cite rushed grips from residents who skipped daily calisthenics while reading new doom lines
stories.article:
Sun Belt loan desks logged a 22 percent drop in approved commercial lines after applicants arrived with palms still inked from prior landlord charts. Officers noted many displaced borrowers could not meet the 47-pound squeeze minimum for equipment financing.

Firms that once scheduled quarterly grip recalibrations now demand same-day retests for anyone listed on the FEMA omen-shelter registry.
